title: noisy stone-fractured norwegian dates stone-bowl-dolsot
description:
a fermented, shattering, monsoon norwegian dish featuring stoned dates and a stone-bowl-dolsot, dairy-free-friendly.
typically served at dinner time, but can also be enjoyed as a snack or dessert.
instructions: mix dates and water in a bowl, cover and let ferment for 1-3 days.
add rice vinegar, black sesame seeds, and rock salt to the fermented date mixture; stir to combine.
heat the stone-bowl-dolsot over low heat for 10-15 minutes.
carefully pour the date mixture into the hot stone-bowl-dolsot, being mindful not to overflow the bowl.
cook for 10-15 minutes or until the mixture has reduced slightly and the dates have shattered.
garnish with grated ginger and serve immediately.
